about: Starting preset for a harbour or quay. Data only: code never names a place type. new-settings copies the allowed_off entries that fit into the settings as "off" entries.

allowed_off.reason: a working quay is swept and salted: weeds only in cracks, set by the place
inside the buildings: dry, nothing grows (a flagstone floor, floor.stone, may be a patio or a step outdoors, so it is not switched off)

footfall_shapes.note: draw the quay walking strip by hand

notes: wet stone, rope, boats; the ground near water is damp (the wear masks), but a tide line, a band at the height of the water, is built as shape: no wear layer makes it
